current_evidence: Thurrock publishes its local requirements only as web pages in the 'Make a planning application' guide ('Information to be submitted with all planning applications', 'Overview of information for specific application types' and this 'Detailed information' page). None of them is dated, and searches found no separate PDF local validation list or adoption date.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only 5 requirements, but the page lists about 20 local requirements with triggers. Missing: Site sections and finished floor/site levels (change in ground levels); Roof plans (roof created or altered); Affordable housing / viability statement (10+ dwellings or site of 0.5ha+); Air quality impact assessment (10+ homes or 500 sqm+ non-residential within the AQMA); Biodiversity survey and report (where impact may be significant); Environmental impact assessment; Flood risk assessment (sites over 1ha in Flood Zone 1 or any new development in Zones 2/3); Health impact assessment; Heritage statement (LBC, or effects on heritage assets); Land contamination assessment (major schemes especially brownfield, EIA schemes, or known contamination); Lighting assessment (external lighting, except householder); Parking and access arrangements (loss or gain of parking); Retail or leisure impact assessment (over 2,500 sqm, or out of centre); Statement of community involvement (large or controversial schemes); Structural survey (barn conversions, reuse of rural buildings, partial demolition of a heritage building); Telecommunications information; Transport assessment (significant vehicle movement or material change on a trunk road).
issues.evidence: Overview page: 'Affordable housing statement / viability statement - 10+ dwellings, or a site of 0.5 hectares or more'; 'Air quality impact assessment - 10+ homes, or 500 sq m+ non-residential space, within the Air Quality Management Area'; Detailed page: 'Lighting assessment ... except for householder developments'.

issues.detail: Every application type except Full planning and Works to trees is shown as '(none)'. Yet the page's requirements apply to Householder (roof plans, site sections/levels, parking where a garage or parking space is lost, tree survey, heritage statement, biodiversity checklist), Listed building consent (heritage statement explicitly required for 'listed building consent'), and Outline (affordable housing, flood risk, transport, contamination, air quality).
issues.evidence: 'Heritage statement: You will only need to provide this with applications for listed building consent, or conservation area consent'; 'Roof plans: ... where a roof would be created or altered'.

issues.detail: The Arboricultural / Tree Survey row is placed under 'Works to trees', but the page's tree survey/arboriculture statement is for development proposals where preserved trees on or next to the site may be affected. It is not a requirement for TPO/conservation-area tree works applications, which should be placed under Full/Householder/Outline. The Block plan, Cycle parking and Travel plan rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' with no basis in the source.
issues.evidence: 'An arboriculture statement is needed for applications where: preserved trees, either on or adjoining the site, may be affected by your proposal'.

issues.detail: The 'Block plan / Site plan' and 'Cycle parking details' rows share one excerpt that runs two requirements together: the Parking and access arrangements text ('Your site plan must show existing and proposed: parking cycle storage access...') followed by the Retail or leisure impact assessment trigger. The real trigger for parking/cycle details is 'applications likely to result in a loss or gain of parking provision'. The Travel Plan trigger quotes content ('must set out how reliance on private motor cars will be reduced') instead of the threshold: non-residential proposals with 50 or more employees.
issues.evidence: 'Parking and access arrangements: You will only need to provide this with applications likely to result in a loss or gain of parking provision'; 'Travel plan: ... non-residential proposals involving 50 employees or more.'

issues.detail: The single tab item (biodiversity checklist exemptions) is cut off mid-word ('Where your checklist shows the need for a b'). The positive trigger for when the biodiversity checklist and survey ARE needed is not captured.
issues.evidence: Biodiversity survey and report: 'where the type and location of development are such that the impact on biodiversity may be significant'.

issues.detail: Only one of the guide's pages was read. Thurrock's local requirements are spread across 'Information to be submitted with all planning applications' (minimum items, DAS exemptions), 'Overview of information for specific application types' (which has fuller triggers, e.g. AH also at 0.5ha+, AQ within the AQMA, FRA in Zones 2/3), and the linked 'Natural habitat sites' and 'Biodiversity net gain' pages. 'Docs read: 1' understates the list.

summary: Grokbot's link is Thurrock's current (undated, web-based) local requirements page, but the capture is very thin. Only 5 of about 20 listed requirements were extracted, most application types are wrongly shown as having no local requirements, and the triggers captured are merged or lack thresholds.
